scope: Overview Launch -> same-session injected bridge readiness -> in-game LWbridge is running -> exact owned Close -> deferred exact restoration
implementationCommitMessage: Complete Overview launch and close lifecycle

deferredRestorationPolicy.reason: Windows locks the active LWScripts.data package while LastWar is running.
deferredRestorationPolicy.duringReadySession: candidate remains installed with exact originals and ownership in recovery journal
deferredRestorationPolicy.onClose: validate profile/session/PID/path journal -> exact-PID normal close -> restore exact originals -> verify hashes -> clear journal
deferredRestorationPolicy.abnormalExit: ownership remains recovering until stop/recovery restores the journaled originals; not reported clean merely because the process disappeared

automaticOwnerEvidence.helper: writes per-session helper-start.json, helper-stop.json and COMPLETE attempt-summary.json
automaticOwnerEvidence.normalDesktop: writes host start/stop build and session correlation into the same per-session evidence directory when the owner uses normal Overview
automaticOwnerEvidence.ownerResponsibility: visible UI observation/screenshots only; no logs, commands, hashes or database work

limits: The original protected launch-proof/ticket and final hello.ack grammar remain unrecovered; this is an explicit independent rebuild policy.
